children: Radico Khaitan Limited has launched Rampur Jugalbandi #7 and #8 India Editions, the final two expressions in its single malt series, as it strengthens its presence in the luxury spirits segment. Limited to 240 bottles, the editions are priced at Rs 50,000 each in Telangana and bottled at 50 per cent ABV. This marks the first and likely last time the Jugalbandi series will be available in the domestic market, with distribution planned across Karnataka, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Telangana.

The launch comes as the company's luxury and semi-luxury portfolio continues to grow, with sales value more than tripling between FY23 and FY26. During FY26, the portfolio recorded sales of Rs 475 crore, with the company targeting around 25 per cent growth in FY27. Its Prestige & Above portfolio registered 35.8 per cent year-on-year volume growth to 5.28 million cases in Q2 FY27, contributing 77.1 per cent of total IMFL sales value.

Commenting on the launch, Abhishek Khaitan, Managing Director, Radico Khaitan Limited, said, “Our ambition is to build Indian spirits brands recognised not just for their quality, but also for their craftsmanship, provenance and ability to create a distinctive experience for consumers. Luxury is built over time through consistency, character and a clear point of view. With Rampur Jugalbandi, we are bringing together rare cask expressions and the craft of Indian single malt-making in an edition created for collectors. This is an important expression of our belief that Indian luxury spirits can command a place among the most admired names in the world.”

The two expressions, Rampur Jugalbandi #7 (Mizunara Cask) and #8 (PX Sherry Cask), complete the eight-part series. Both were first unveiled at TFWA Cannes in 2025 for global markets and are now making their India debut.

Jugalbandi #7 combines ex-Bourbon and Japanese Mizunara oak cask maturation, while #8 brings together ex-Bourbon and Pedro Ximénez sherry cask maturation. The two expressions explore contrasting cask influences, combining Indian single malt with Japanese oak and Spanish sherry cask characteristics.
